messages:
lisa_sales: Acme POC hit a wall — they're getting 401s and some 403s when switching projects. Can we triage?
acme_engineer: Started yesterday, most requests 401 Invalid API key. Sometimes 403 Forbidden when we change the project id header. Using key from onboarding email.
james_se: Quick check: are you sending any additional tenant/org headers? We recently added support for `X-RWD-Org-Id` in the SDK, if that's set and doesn't match the key binding you can get 403.
acme_engineer: No, we don't set that header explicitly. We're using the JS SDK which might add `X-RWD-Org-Id`. I'll paste our config.
acme_engineer: `const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RWD_KEY, orgId: process.env.RWD_ORG });`
eli_infra: There's the clue — the SDK attaches orgId if present. If the env var is wrong it will override token binding and produce 403.
acme_engineer: Hmm, our env had `RWD_ORG=org-alpha` from an old sandbox. The PoC org is `org-acme`.
james_se: Two paths: rotate/generate a key bound to org-alpha for sandbox work, or fix env to org-acme. For immediate unblock, I'll generate a scoped PoC key for org-acme.
ops_bot: secrets-service: created key `rwd-test_acme_swarm_7b` bound_org: org-acme, scopes: [inference:generate, embeddings:read], expires: 72h, status: active, id: rwd-test_acme_swarm_7b.
acme_engineer: Replaced env var and restarted the service. Getting 200s now. Thanks.
lisa_sales: Great. Two follow-ups from Acme: 1) they saw intermittent 429s when running concurrent embedding batches, 2) security team asked whether keys can be scoped to "embeddings only" and have IP restrictions.
james_se: 429 behavior is expected at scale — default burst window is 100req/min for hosted PoC accounts. For embeddings batching use chunking and spacing, and use exponential backoff with jitter.
acme_engineer: Any recommended initial rate to avoid 429s?
james_se: Start at 40rpm per client and ramp up by 10% every minute while observing `x-rwd-remaining` header. If you hit 429, backoff x2 for 1s + jitter. I'll DM a snippet.
eli_infra: On security: we support scope-limited keys (embeddings-only) for hosted keys and CIDR-based IP allowlist for enterprise Dedicated/Private. For hosted PoC we can create an embeddings-only key bound to their org. IP allowlist needs an enterprise tenant.
lisa_sales: @eli_infra please create an embeddings-only key for their PoC and note IP allowlist requirements for their security doc.
ops_bot: secrets-service: created key `rwd-test_acme_embed_21` bound_org: org-acme, scopes: [embeddings:read], expires: 168h, status: active.
acme_engineer: Swapped and tested embeddings call, works and no 429s at the reduced rate. Sending our security questionnaire answers now.
james_se: One more note for the docs: SDK should surface when an attached orgId conflicts with key binding. I'll open a small PR to add an explicit warning log when mismatch detected.
lisa_sales: Thanks team. I'll include the key ids and rate guidance in the PoC summary and send next steps to Acme security. Closing this swarm unless anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
